title: Civic Notice: The Grid
description: A Snazzie FM Civic Notification System test. The municipal grid will reclaim the light it loaned you. Leave one window lit. The dark has agreed to be brief.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: This is a test of the Snazzie F M Civic Notification System. <p:0.5> Tonight, between two and four, the grid will reclaim the light it loaned you.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: When the streetlights dim, do not replace them. <p:0.5> The dark has been scheduled, and it has agreed to be brief.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: Leave one window lit. <p:0.3> The grid will know which one. <p:0.5> Do not look to see why.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-deep
lines.text: This concludes the test of the Snazzie F M Civic Notification System. <p:0.5> The lights are off now. <p:0.5> You turned them off yourself.
